plans.goal: Scare the pack away by using fire and noise as intimidation.
steps: Grab the torch and use it to create a wall of flame.
Direct Borin and Pip to make noise and appear more threatening than they are.
Force the wolves to retreat rather than engage in a prolonged fight.

atoms.strategy: Seize the nearby torch and brandish it.
atoms.text: Pick up the torch. Make yourself look big and dangerous. Wolves fear fire.

atoms.strategy: Use the campfire as an extension of the threat.
atoms.text: Circle the campfire so the wolves see us backed by flames. Make yourself a bigger target.

atoms.strategy: Distract and intimidate with coordinated noise.
atoms.text: Borin, Pip, shout and wave weapons. Make noise like a dozen warriors.

atoms.strategy: Press the advantage and drive them back.
atoms.text: Old wolf looks done for. If the pack sees one of their own fall, they'll run. End it.

plans.goal: Finish the Old wolf quickly, then use its death to break the pack's will.
steps: Identify the Old wolf as the easy target with 1 HP.
Strike it down with overwhelming force.
Let the surviving wolves see their elder fall and lose their courage.

atoms.strategy: Focus fire on the weakest link.
atoms.text: The old one's nearly dead. Everyone strike it down now.

atoms.strategy: Make the kill decisive and visible.
atoms.text: Borin, strike it down where the whole pack can see. Show them what happens to those who don't flee.

atoms.strategy: Use the psychological impact to break the pack's morale.
atoms.text: Now the rest of you scatter before we do the same to you. Go. Live.

plans.goal: Lure the wolves into the fire hazards to weaken them without direct combat.
steps: Use torch and campfire strategically to create a dangerous zone.
Drag the wolves or their path toward the burning tent.
Let the environment do half the work while we defend ourselves.

atoms.strategy: Ignite the tent to create an obstacle.
atoms.text: Ignite the tent. Burn it and force the wolves to navigate the flames.

atoms.strategy: Use the torch to threaten and guide wolf movement.
atoms.text: Pip, swing the torch in wide arcs. Make them fear the fire more than they want our blood.

atoms.strategy: Take advantage of their hesitation to escape.
atoms.text: If the flames hold them back long enough, we retreat to higher ground. Let the fire be our wall.

atoms.strategy: Finish any stragglers who press through.
atoms.text: Any wolf that breaks through the flames learns what the torch really does. Attack those that come at us.
